description: How scripts/rule discovers code that can stop a flow: every file matching glob (from the repository root), every line matching regex; group 1 names the function, so a match is <file>:<function>. The default is the RULE-AUDIT census pattern (docs/units/RULE-AUDIT/audit.md), so both counts agree. A match that no active record lists in where is an unregistered stop.
